summary: Phase 3 Session 2 — AI JE Drafters tested end-to-end. All 6 preexisting unit tests pass. Wrote 10 new HTTP integration tests exercising scan/list/patch/approve/reject/role-gating on live backend with Bright Beans seed data — all pass after a small fix. Frontend Playwright confirmed panel renders, scan populates prepaid amort draft, T-account expansion shows Debit/Credit columns, Post button approves and removes card, and toast fires. Client role correctly 403s.

minor.issue: Returned 500 (BSON ObjectId not JSON-serializable) because handler returned raw Mongo doc via `find_one(...) | {}`. Fixed by routing through coerce().

integration_issues.issue: Navigating to /accounting/month-close?ym=2026-02 loads September 2026 instead of February 2026 — the `ym` query param is ignored by MonthClose; AdjustPhasePanel therefore scans the default month. Not a JE-drafters defect, but flagged for MonthClose page work.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Make MonthClose honor the `ym` (and cid) URL query params so deep-links land on the requested period; otherwise the AI Adjust Drafts panel scans the wrong month when opened via a link.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /je-drafters/{id} previously returned `find_one(...) | {}` which serializes Mongo _id and 500s. Fix applied; consider using coerce() everywhere a raw doc is returned.

`_draft_prepaid_amortizations` uses `balance/12` as a flat heuristic when no amortization_config is set — good MVP, but any prepaid re-loaded mid-schedule (e.g. Prepaid Rent recharged) will restart the 12-month divisor. Consider persisting a per-account schedule at first drafter run.
`_draft_recurring_accruals` variance filter uses `max(avg*0.25, 10)` — reasonable but not tunable per company; consider exposing threshold in company settings.
Approve handler builds new uuid and passes both `id` and `insert_je` — verify insert_je isn't re-generating id and dropping the passed one (currently OK per test assertion).
Panel component uses `toast.error` on load failure but no retry/backoff — minor.

context_for_next_testing_agent: je_drafters HTTP tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_je_drafters_api.py and require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var — export it before pytest or add to conftest. Unit tests in test_je_drafters.py run directly. PATCH returning raw Mongo doc is a repeat pattern — grep for `find_one(...) | {}` or similar across new routes.
rca of the issue: PATCH /je-drafters/{id} 500 → root cause: handler returned `await db.je_drafts.find_one(...) | {}` directly to FastAPI, so the response included Mongo's ObjectId `_id` which jsonable_encoder cannot serialize (`TypeError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable`). Reproduction: PATCH any pending draft with `{memo: 'x'}`. Mitigation: wrap doc in existing `coerce()` helper before returning (applied).
